queries.title: Search keywords (optional)
queries.description: Leave empty to use the built-in GTA 6 / GTA VI / leak / trailer / release-date set.

when.title: Recency
when.description: Only keep headlines published in this Google News time window.

kind.title: Only this kind
kind.description: Optional classifier filter: official, leak, trailer, gameplay, release, rumor or other.

onlyGtaRelated.title: Drop off-topic headlines
onlyGtaRelated.description: Keep only headlines that mention GTA, Grand Theft Auto or Rockstar Games.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google News language code, e.g. en.

country.title: Country
country.description: Google News country / edition code, e.g. US.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Optional after: date (YYYY-MM-DD) added to each query.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Optional before: date (YYYY-MM-DD) added to each query.

maxItems.title: Max articles
maxItems.description: Hard cap on articles returned (and charged) in this run.

decodeUrls.title: Decode publisher URLs
decodeUrls.description: Resolve Google News redirect links to the publisher URL when possible.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many RSS feeds to fetch in parallel (1–20).
